source: day 2: a draft PR had to choose between sending a due date and having another team's connector compute it; the follow-up 'note it for the other team' lived in chat and the draft PR was not in the ledger. Replayed with outreach: the session records the question on its item, I reject the first wording, the DM goes out, one nudge, and the reply in the DM is matched and handed back to the session.
setup: bosun ledger upsert 'slack:C0000000003/1700000035.000035' --kind mention --title 'Marco: the ERP sync drops payment terms'
bosun ledger record-delegation 'slack:C0000000003/1700000035.000035' --window exporter --task new-work --ask 'send payment terms in the ERP sync'

steps.why: the fork in the design, recorded with the options
run: bosun ledger reach-out 'slack:C0000000003/1700000035.000035' --to 'ERP connector team (Omar)' --purpose decision --subject 'Due dates: we send due_date with each invoice, or the connector computes it from payment_terms?' --option 'a) we send due_date (recommended)' --option 'b) the connector computes it' --details - <<'EOF'
Draft PR https://github.com/acme/exporter/pull/111 implements a). b) needs a change in the connector.

steps.why: the PR itself becomes a tracked item too
steps.run: bosun ledger upsert 'mypr:acme/exporter#111' --kind my-pr --title 'Payment terms in the ERP sync (draft)' --url https://github.com/acme/exporter/pull/111

steps.why: nothing else left: the report says what waits
steps.run: bosun ledger report 'slack:C0000000003/1700000035.000035' --summary 'Draft PR #111 sends payment_terms and due_date' --result https://github.com/acme/exporter/pull/111 --open 'waiting on out:slack:C0000000003/1700000035.000035/1 (due date source)'

bosun ledger propose 'out:slack:C0000000003/1700000035.000035/1' 'Slack DM to Omar: Hi Omar, the ERP sync now sends payment terms. Should we send the due date too, or would the connector rather compute it from the terms? Draft: https://github.com/acme/exporter/pull/111'

steps.why: I want different wording: rejected, back to draft
steps.run: bosun ledger resolve 'out:slack:C0000000003/1700000035.000035/1' rejected --note 'shorter, lead with the recommendation'

bosun ledger propose 'out:slack:C0000000003/1700000035.000035/1' 'Slack DM to Omar: We plan to send due_date with each synced invoice, next to payment_terms. OK for the connector? Draft: https://github.com/acme/exporter/pull/111'

steps.why: no reply after the nudge window: a proposed follow-up, then sent
run: bosun ledger propose 'out:slack:C0000000003/1700000035.000035/1' 'Slack DM to Omar: friendly ping on the due date question'

steps.why: a later message in that DM is the reply
recorded and handed back to the session
run: bosun ledger replied 'out:slack:C0000000003/1700000035.000035/1' --evidence https://acme.slack.com/archives/D0000000005/p1700000070000070 --summary 'a) is fine; the connector uses due_date when it is there'
out: would deliver to replay:exporter: Update to ledger item slack:C0000000003/1700000035.000035

steps.run: bosun ledger transition 'slack:C0000000003/1700000035.000035' done --note 'PR #111 tracked as mypr'
